theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_mt_cc_support_smul_boundary
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (c : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = c * T.boundary ω) → S.support ⊆ T.support
